tools.description: Get one public product by id, including its purchasable variants. Use an id from search_products results.

id.description: The product id, from a search or list result.

tools.name: get_product

ApiCategory.description: The product's category as exposed to agents.

id.description: Category id; null when the product has none.

name.description: Category name (the product's snapshot of it).

ApiRating.description:
The product's rating as exposed to agents: the live reviews
aggregate. `average` is null when the product has no
reviews — the API reports the honest aggregate and never
invents one.

average.description: Average rating rounded to one decimal; null at 0 reviews.

count.description: Number of reviews behind the average.

ApiTag.description: One tag on a product, as exposed to agents.

slug.description: Stable ASCII identifier (the agent's matching key).

ApiVariant.description:
One purchasable combination of a product, as exposed to
agents: the cart keys on the variant id.

label.description:
Combination label, e.g. `サイズ: M / カラー: ブラック`;
empty for the default variant of a plain product.

price_yen.description:
The combination's price in integer yen: its own price
when it has one, else the product's effective price.

purchasable.description:
Whether this combination can be bought right now,
under the same rule as the product-level flag.

stock.description: Units in stock for this combination.

allow_backorder.description: Whether the product can be ordered beyond its stock.

path.description: Storefront path of the product page.

price_yen.description:
Current selling price in integer yen, tax included,
after any active sale — the price a buyer would pay.

purchasable.description:
Whether the product can be bought right now, under the
same rule the cart applies: untracked stock or backorder
is always buyable; tracked stock needs a unit on hand.

rating.description: Live reviews aggregate for this product.

stock.description: Stock summed over the product's enabled variants.

tags.description: The product's tags from the controlled vocabulary.

variants.description:
The product's purchasable combinations. Present on the
detail response only — the list stays a summary — so an
agent chooses a combination from the detail it already
fetched before adding to a cart.

tools.description: Get the store's identity and shopping basics: name, tagline, description, contact, the flat shipping fee and the free-shipping threshold in yen.
tools.name: get_store_info

contact_email.description: Public contact email; empty when the shop shows none.

contact_url.description: Public contact page URL; empty when the shop shows none.

currency.description: Currency every price on this surface uses.

free_shipping_threshold_yen.description:
Product subtotal at or above which shipping is free,
in integer yen.

shipping_flat_yen.description: Flat shipping fee in integer yen, tax included.

tools.description: List the store's product categories (id, name, slug, parent) so searches can be filtered by category name.
tools.name: list_categories

ApiCategoryEntry.description: One product category as exposed to machine clients.

name.description: Display name — the value search filters match on.

parent_id.description: Parent category id; null at the top level.

tools.description: Search the store's public catalog by keyword, with optional category, price-range and stock filters and several sort orders. Returns one page of products with prices in integer yen (tax included), stock and ratings — exactly what the storefront shows.

category.description: Category name, exactly as `list_categories` reports it.

in_stock_only.description: Keep only products with stock on hand.

max_price_yen.description: Highest price to keep, in integer yen (inclusive).

min_price_yen.description: Lowest price to keep, in integer yen (inclusive).

query.description:
Keyword text matched against product names and
categories (multi-term AND). Empty or omitted browses
the whole catalog.

sort.description:
One of: recommended, newest, price_asc, price_desc,
rating. Defaults to recommended.

tools.name: search_products
